messages:
niya: Hey team — customer reported the /rerank API returning null/empty scores only when using the Python SDK v0.9.2. Direct curl requests return numeric scores fine. Repro and snippets below.

alex (support): Thanks, @niya. Can you paste the minimal repro and the raw request/response from both curl and the SDK? Also which model and rerank params? :eyes:

niya (customer): Model is `open-rerank-1`. They use a list of 10 candidates and 1 query. Params: top_k=10, normalize_scores=true.

niya (customer): Python SDK call exactly:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
res = client.rerank(query="best payment gateway",
                    candidates=[{"id": "c1", "text": "Stripe"}, {"id": "c2", "text": "PayPal"}],
                    normalize_scores=True)
print(res.scores)
```

niya (customer): Output from SDK: `['null', 'null']` (strings) — but curl returns `[0.83, 0.17]` (numbers).

alex (support): Interesting — do you have the raw HTTP payloads? Headers and body for both?

niya (customer): Curl (works):```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"open-rerank-1","query":"best payment gateway","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Stripe"},{"id":"c2","text":"PayPal"}],"normalize_scores":true}'
# response body:
# {"scores":[0.83,0.17],"ranked_indices":[0,1]}
```

niya (customer): Python SDK (broken):```http
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <snip>
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"open-rerank-1","query":"best payment gateway","candidates":"[{\"id\": \"c1\", \"text\": \"Stripe\"}, {\"id\": \"c2\", \"text\": \"PayPal\"}]","normalize_scores":true}
# response body:
# {"scores":["null","null"],"ranked_indices":[0,1]}
```

alex (support): Aha — the SDK sent `candidates` as a stringified JSON array (looks like `candidates` is a string in the body). That would explain the server-side parser returning nulls (type mismatch) and our response marshalling sending string "null" back.

samuel (eng-ml): Jumping in. This matches a bug we shipped in py-sdk v0.9.2 where we accidentally `json.dumps()` the entire `candidates` list when building the request if the user passed a list of dicts and we detect older formatting. Reproducer in unit tests:
```python
# bad behavior
body = {"candidates": json.dumps([{"id":"c1"}])}  # -> sends string
```
Server treats non-array types as invalid and returns placeholder nulls in the score array to keep schema.

samuel (eng-ml): Quick mitigation: use the raw HTTP call (curl) or downgrade to py-sdk v0.9.1. We have a patch on main to stop double-serializing. Will cut a hotfix.

maya (devex): For customers who can't change versions immediately, workaround in Python: ensure you pass a JSON-serializable native object and avoid pre-dumping. Example:```python
# workaround
from json import loads, dumps
cands = [{"id":"c1","text":"Stripe"}, {"id":"c2","text":"PayPal"}]
# ensure not pre-dumped by any wrapper
res = client._http_post('/v1/rerank', json={"model":"open-rerank-1","query":"best payment gateway","candidates": cands, "normalize_scores": True})
```
(we know `_http_post` is internal but works as a short-term bridge)

niya (customer): Thanks. Could this also explain weird lexicographic sorts reported by another team (TS SDK)? They saw strings like `"0.9","0.12"` and got wrong ordering.

samuel (eng-ml): Yes — across clients, if numeric scores come back as strings they'll sort lexicographically in JS and produce wrong ranking. We saw a TS client bug separately where parsing used `parseInt` on floats then compared. We'll add regression tests for both.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: hotfix/py-sdk-0.9.3 -> CI tests running. [link-to-ci] :rocket:

alex (support): Thanks @samuel @maya — I'll reply to the customer with repro + workaround and ETA for patch. Please ping when 0.9.3 is cut.

samuel (eng-ml): Patch merged to hotfix branch. Cut to release in ~30m if CI passes. Change is to stop double-serializing and validate `candidates` is list before sending. Add note to changelog.

niya (customer): Confirmed workaround works for them. They see numeric scores from same env now. Will wait for patch and let us know if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

alex (support): Closing on our side once release published. Marking this incident as "SDK: py rerank serialization" and creating GH issue to backport.

maya (devex): I'll prepare a small code example for the docs and add an FAQ entry: "Why am I getting null scores?" with this exact symptom.

alex (support): Great. Thanks everyone.
